Name: Expenses Web
Purpose: The ordinary confidential web app, granted through a role rather than to people

Name: Payroll Console
Purpose: Granted to Finance, whose audience a mapping widens, and posting its secret in the body rather than a header

Name: Contractor Portal SPA
Purpose: A public client with PKCE and no secret, granted only to contractors

Name: Field App
Purpose: A native client with a custom scheme redirect, hidden from the portal and granted to no role, which an inventory still has to list and a review still has to explain

Name: Wiki SAML
Purpose: SAML rather than OIDC, so anything that assumes every app has a client id has one that does not; granted to two roles
